## Why release now?

What should go into the next release? Link related PRs or issues if you can.

## Suggested version

- Current: see `VERSION` on `main`
- Suggested: patch / minor / major (or a concrete version, e.g. `0.6.0`)

## What to highlight

List user-facing changes, new connectors, or fixes that belong in the notes.

## Extra context

Anything the maintainer should know before cutting the release.
